Learned APP submits that charge sheet was filed in this case against the five accused persons.

Murari Lal Thakur, Kumari Meenu and Sri Niwas Mathur were discharged by the trial court vide order dated 12.04.2010 while charges were framed under Section 406/498A IPC and Section 4 DP Act against the present petitioner Mukesh Kumar Mathur and under Section 406/34 IPC against Kusum Mathur.
Thereafter, the petitioner was declared a proclaimed offender and vide judgment dated 23.01.2018, Kusum Mathur has been acquitted.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner states that petitioner has since surrendered and granted bail vide order dated 04.07.2018 and has been facing the trial.
